metadata.description: 3x3 dual directed mesh following the supplied diagram: nine storage endpoints P00-P22 (memory-only P11 and eight processing endpoints), nine NoC0 routers R00-R22 carrying traffic east/south, and nine NoC1 routers r00-r22 carrying traffic west/north. R and r are case-sensitive node identities; coordinates are descriptive only. The NoCs have no direct router-to-router interconnection. Each endpoint uses distinct storage ports for the two NoCs; storage access does not provide implicit transit between them. Corner asymmetry is explicit in topology: no R00->P00, P00->r00, P22->R22, or r22->P22 connection. Fixed port signatures are retained, including unconnected corner and mesh-edge ports; there is no wraparound or external interface. Each ingress may select any one egress; packet replication is not declared. Resource values and endpoint services follow the existing mesh demo: 256-bit ports, 4 VCs per forwarding ingress with depth 4 flits, 1-flit storage ingress FIFO, 4-GiB (4294967296-byte) P11 main memory and 1.5-MiB (1572864-byte) storage on each other P endpoint, with int8, fp16, and fp32 numeric processing on those eight endpoints; dense and sum use int32 accumulation for int8 and fp32 accumulation for fp16, preserving the original int8/int8/int32/int32 dense signature. Each of the eight processing endpoints also declares reorder, sum/max/min, all twenty basic elementwise operations, all ten floating-point math operations, gather/scatter in axis/coordinate/flat forms, and tensor_fill. Floating-point math is fp16/fp32 only; logical operations and predicates use bool, indices use int64, and casts include int32 for the widened integer results. Per processing endpoint, dense throughput is 32x8x16 = 4096 MACs/cycle, reduce throughput is 512 combines/cycle, elementwise_basic throughput is 32x32 = 1024 elements/cycle, and elementwise_math throughput is 32x8 = 256 elements/cycle. Indexed access remains 1 access/cycle. These throughput declarations do not specify complete Event latency. Node frequency is 1000 MHz. P11 is the sole main-memory node and declares storage only; data-movement events are owned by the other endpoints. Demo type, mechanism, and policy names do not establish implemented or validated simulator components.
